summary.headline: Astrological Time Lords
summary.text: Astrological instructions for determining the relation governing a time from Zeus/Jupiter, malefics, planetary latitudes, decans, conjunctions, full moons, eclipses, houses, angles, and term-rulers. It explains how horoskopos, midheaven, setting, subterranean places, seasonal quadrants, ingresses, and celestial signs indicate beginnings, middle events, outcomes, and universal or partial changes.
